name: clean-code
about: Least slop: Claude plans, Codex writes the code. SlopCodeBench (code that stays clean as an agent keeps extending it) puts Codex's GPT-6 Astra at xhigh at the top.

why.research: Opus 5.5: best single model in a stock CLI on SWE-Atlas-QnA.
why.code: GPT-6 Astra at xhigh: SlopCodeBench second overall (31.6% isolated solve), best strict solve (16.3%) and the least verbose code of any entry (0.158). Fix chains extend code session after session, which is what SlopCodeBench measures.
